content:
anya: Heads-up — preview queue is stacking: 4 docs PRs waiting for review/merge. Can we split ownership quickly?
sam: Which PRs exactly? numbers pls.
anya: PRs: #2487 (migration guide: nomad -> dedicated), #2490 (python sdk snippet update), #2492 (link fixes for auth section), #2495 (tiny copy + example for batching).
elaine: I can take one of the migration ones. low bandwidth today though.
chris: I can do #2490 (python snippet) and smoke test it locally.
sam: I'll pick #2492 (link fixes) — should be quick.
anya: @elaine would you prefer #2487 or #2495? #2487 has a couple of config blocks and a table to validate.
elaine: I'll take #2495 (copy + batching example) actually — faster. Take #2487 if someone can sanity-check the kv-cache table.
chris: @anya I can give #2487 a quick pass after I finish #2490. but need the preview link.
docs-bot: deploy-preview available: https://deploy-preview-2487--docs.redwood.example/ (staging), linkcheck ran  — 1 warning (old-nomad-docs).
anya: thanks bot. FYI #2487 triggers linkcheck 429 intermittently in CI (rate limit on external api). Might need to rerun.
sam: if CI flaked, we shouldn't block the reviewer. Elaine/Chris can do a manual quick smoke on preview and comment. Then we'll retrigger CI for merge.
elaine: agreed. can manual-verify the tables and the example commands. will comment inline with any nitpicks.
chris: Quick checklist for reviewers:
```
- open deploy-preview link
- run the example commands in local virtualenv (when applicable)
- verify code fence languages and SDK snippets match repo tests
- confirm no dead links in section headings
```
anya: perfect. Also: we have a rotation hole today — sasha is OOO and reviewer-rotation channel didn't catch it. we'll need to mark coverage gap so rotation leads can fix tomorrow.
sam: can we add a one-off reviewer tag on the PRs so ops knows these were triaged? e.g., `reviewer:ad-hoc`
anya: done — added label and pinged @doc-rotation-leads.
docs-bot: CI rerun scheduled for #2487 at 2026-03-21T15:12:00Z. linkcheck status: unstable -> pending.
chris: I tested #2490 snippet on py3.11, output matches. left one inline suggestion about an import path.
elaine: verified #2495 examples and copy. just small nits, nothing blocking.
sam: #2492 link fix verified, merged. :tada:
anya: ok we'll merge #2490 and #2495 after minor fixes. I'll retrigger #2487 linkcheck once the external API backoff clears.
chris: thanks all. can someone add a note to the rotation doc that coverage gaps = "escalate to eng-docs-oncall" so it doesn't fall through?
anya: adding a short blurb to the rotation README now.
sam: re: ownership — maybe for tomorrow we temporarily assign one extra reviewer per shift for migration PRs. saves juggling.
elaine: +1. also happy to swap shifts if someone is blocked.
anya: sounds good. I'll add that to the agenda for the next docs sync.
docs-bot: thread closed for inactivity after 1h.
